aspects.name: TemplateDriven
aspects.text: Uses the approved internal communications template and follows the standard style guide.

aspects.name: PlainLanguageFocused
aspects.text: Writes using plain-language and inclusive tone guidelines.

aspects.name: ReviewOriented
aspects.text: Routes drafts to the relevant communications lead for review and waits for final sign-off before approval.

concepts.definition: The creation of internal company communications such as newsletters, announcements, update digests, and executive briefs.
Regularly scheduled summary communications that compile updates over time.
Internal memoranda intended for executive-level readers.
Urgent communications used during a crisis; explicitly out of scope for this task family.
Newsletter-style communications distributed within the organization.
Brief summary updates that collect recent information into a digest format.
Concise briefing documents prepared for executives.
The person responsible for reviewing the draft and providing final sign-off.
The required standard document format that must be used for drafting.
Rules requiring clear, simple wording that is easy to understand.
Guidelines for writing in a respectful, inclusive manner.
A field indicating workflow state, with values such as drafting, ready for review, or approved.
